message:
The other night, we had a surprise power outage that lasted longer than expected. My kiddos initially thought it was the best adventure ever—running around with flashlights and making shadow puppets on the walls. I couldn’t help but smile, but I also knew we needed to keep things rolling smoothly. 

So, I grabbed our trusty power bank for the phones and plugged in a couple of portable lanterns to keep the atmosphere cozy. We even made a little game out of figuring out which snacks were best to eat from the fridge before things started to warm up! 

It turned into a fun evening, but it reminded me how important it is to be ready for these little surprises. What are some of your favorite tips to stay comfy during a blackout?
